title: The Brückner Group – a global technology company - K Trade Fair
content: ##### Brückner Group GmbH. # The Brückner Group – a global technology company. The Brückner Group has been a family-owned company since it was established in 1960. It stands for technological expertise and the highest quality in the field of machinery and installations for the production and processing of plastics and other packaging materials. * Brückner Group: Strategic management holding and management company for all business areas of the Brückner Group. * Brückner Maschinenbau: World market leader in production installations for the manufacture of films for high-quality packaging material and technical applications. * Kiefel: The leader in serial and special machinery for the processing of plastics in the automobile, refrigeration, medical technology and packaging industries. * PackSys Global: Global player for special machines for the packaging industry. The companies within the group operate independently but share a focus on engineering as their core added value as well as their striving for leadership in technology and on the world market in their individual segments.

title: History and High Points - Brückner Group
content: What began as a medium-sized enterprise has grown into a global technology leader with firm roots, sustainable growth, and a spirit of curiosity and openness. Our four specialized business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel, and PackSys Global – bring together in-depth expertise in film manufacturing, servicing, industrial processing of PUR, thermoforming, and packaging. The founding of Paul Kiefel GmbH marks the first chapter in the story of a company that would become an integral part of the Brückner Group. What began as a small mechanical engineering firm laid the foundation for decades of technological expertise in plastic processing. In the following decades, the company evolves from a purely manufacturing business into a global engineering firm. With the inception of Brückner Far East, the company takes a visionary step into Asian markets. With Brückner Colombia, the Group takes its global presence into South America for the first time.
